_comment: PlantScope v4 — houseplant-relevant classes. Stage-1 detector is single-class (leaf); disease decision is owned by Stage 2.

training.cutmix_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
training.quantization: dynamic INT8 on MatMul (final classifier) only; Conv layers remain FP32. Per-channel INT8 on full graph degraded acc to ~0.85 due to EfficientNet SE-block weight outliers, MatMul-only is the production path.
